Ahmad Faruqui is an expert in economics and energy policy, particularly known for his work on electricity markets, demand response, and energy efficiency. He has contributed extensively to the understanding of power system economics and has advised utilities, regulators, and governments on energy policy and market design.

Faruqui has written numerous papers, articles, and reports on these topics and is recognized for his expertise in pricing strategies, tariff design, and demand-side management. He has spoken at conferences worldwide and has been involved with various institutions involved in energy research and policy.

If you want more specific details about his career, publications, or contributions, please let me know!
